title: Stud Rail Master driver manifest
description: Shared between the ESP32 firmware (C++) and the PC app (Python). Both implementations must reproduce every test vector byte for byte.

id.description: Hub type key stored in configs ("type" field).

kind.description: gatt = one BLE connection per hub; advert = connectionless broadcast, one sender for many hubs.

namePrefix.description: Advertised name prefix used to recognise the hub in a scan.

advertisedService.description: Service UUID in the advertisement used to recognise the hub in a scan.

notify.description: gatt only: subscribe to notifications on the write characteristic.

flags.description: Value of the Flags AD structure that must precede the manufacturer data.

sharedSpeed.description: Port groups that can only run at one common speed.

slots.description: advert only: hubs addressable by one telegram.

pairMs.description: advert only: how long the pairing telegram is sent.

heartbeatMs.description: Resend interval even when nothing changes.

armWithStop.description: gatt only: stop packets to send right after connecting.

watchdog.description: true = the hub stops by itself when commands stop arriving.

vectors.description: Test vectors, keyed by function name. See drivers/README.md.
